test-code.description: a static helper is reported
an instance method is not reported
a static factory returning the enclosing type is reported: a constructor is the compliant form
a static method assigning a private static field is not reported
a compound assignment counts as a write
an increment counts as a write
a decrement counts as a write
a static accessor over a private static field is reported: a read is not a write
a mutating call on a private static field is reported: put cannot be told from size
writing a non-private static field is not an exception
writing a private instance field through a receiver is not writing static state
writing a local variable that shadows the field is not writing the field
a static native method has no body and writes nothing
a sealed utility class is exempt
a public class with an implicit constructor is not a utility class
a package-private class with an implicit constructor is a utility class
a protected constructor disqualifies the type
one instance method disqualifies the type
an instance field does not disqualify a utility class
an interface with only static methods is exempt: it has no constructor
an interface with a default method is not exempt
an enum with no instance methods is exempt: its implicit constructor is private
nested types are evaluated independently
a main method is not reported
a method named main with a different signature is reported
a JUnit lifecycle method is not reported: JUnit requires it to be static
a fully qualified lifecycle annotation is recognised too
a MethodSource provider is reported: nothing distinguishes it from any other static
an unrelated annotation does not exempt a static helper
several static helpers in one class are each reported
